question: Which of the following is the most environment-friendly method of disposing of organic wastes?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Composting**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **biological process** allows the organic component of the waste to decompose in strictly regulated circumstances.
 
• The material is transformed into richly nutritious manure or **compost** after composting.
 
• In **agricultural settings**, it serves as a **soil conditioner** and adds nutrients.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is "**Composting**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Other techniques for disposing of municipal solid waste

 
• **Incineration**:

 
• It involves **burning trash** in huge furnaces.
 
• The recyclable materials are separated in these facilities, and the remaining materials are burned.
 
• When the procedure is through, nothing but ash is left.

 
• Landfill: The most popular, cheap, and environmentally responsible way to get rid of solid garbage. It is utilized in cities where a lot of trash is produced. It is a pit that is excavated in the earth and covered after disposing of the trash to stop rats and flies from reproducing.
 
• Pulverization: 
 
 
• This approach involves using grinding machines to turn collected solid waste into powder adjusting its size and physical attributes Landfilling is used to dispose of this crushed solid waste in the future.
 
 
 
• **Recycling**:
 
 
• It describes the process of removing waste-related objects so they can be used as raw materials in the production of new goods.
